args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after health check failures
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate ~18%). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. First rollback attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, us-west/eu-west remained on v2.3.1); a second rollback completed the rollout to v2.3.0 in all regions. Service is now healthy (error rate ~0.2%).

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` (unhealthy, ~18% error rate) across all regions. The most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.

2. **Rolled back**: The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, but us-west/eu-west remained on v2.3.1). A second rollback completed the rollout, bringing all regions to `v2.3.0`.

3. **Verified recovery**: Service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.

4. **Opened incident**: The `create_incident` call timed out, but I confirmed via `list_incidents` that the SEV2 incident was actually created (INC-0001) and is open, describing the rollback and recovery.

transcript.content:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` (unhealthy, ~18% error rate) across all regions. The most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.

2. **Rolled back**: The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, but us-west/eu-west remained on v2.3.1). A second rollback completed the rollout, bringing all regions to `v2.3.0`.

3. **Verified recovery**: Service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.

4. **Opened incident**: The `create_incident` call timed out, but I confirmed via `list_incidents` that the SEV2 incident was actually created (INC-0001) and is open, describing the rollback and recovery.
